characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Shooting Weapon

Range 24", Shots D6, Str 4, AP 2, Quick to Fire.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model can cast Chilling Howl (Shamanism) as a Bound Spell with Power Level (4/8). Enemy units within 9" of one or more Frost Mammoths suffer -3 Agility. While in base contact with one or more Frost Mammoths, enemy units that Break from Combat gain Minimised (Flee Distance).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

If on foot, the model gains Exclusive (Yetis, Sabretooth Tigers); ignore the Insignificant rule for joining units. If mounted, it gains Exclusive. A model with Loner cannot join a unit containing any other Characters, and Characters cannot join a unit containing a model with Loner.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The Mammoth Hunter's base size is changed to 50×50 SI. As long the model is joined to a unit of Sabretooth Tigers, the unit (including the Mammoth Hunter) gains Swift Reform and Vanguard, and the Mammoth Hunter counts as being a Standard Beast for the purposes of distributing hits, except for Stomp Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Attack Attribute

The model's Impact Hits gain +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's unit may reroll failed Discipline Tests unless Fleeing.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Each unit of Scrapling Trappers may place a Trap Counter:
  • Right before the battle (during step 7 of the Deployment Phase Sequence), on a single Terrain Feature other than Open Terrain that the unit was deployed in or was in contact with at any point during its Vanguard move
  • Once during each friendly Movement Phase, on a single Terrain Feature other than Open Terrain that the unit was in contact with during an Advance Move, March Move, or a Reform in this phase
If an enemy unit performs an Advance Move, March Move, Reform, Pivot, Charge Move, Failed Charge Move, Pursuit Move, Overrun Move, or Flee Move inside or into contact with a Terrain Feature with one or more Trap Counters, remove all Trap Counters in that particular Terrain Feature. Each model in the unit must take a Dangerous Terrain (1) Test. These tests are not considered to be caused by the Terrain Feature; any Dangerous Terrain Tests that would normally be caused by the Terrain Feature still need to be taken.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Artillery Weapon

Catapult (5×5), Range 12--48", Shots 1, Str 3, AP 1, Lethal Strike.
A Scratapult that only Pivots (and moves no further) during its owner's Movement Phase ignores the to-hit modifier from Moving and Shooting in the next Shooting Phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Deafening Clamour, Sons of the Avalanche, and counts as a Character for the purpose of Sons of the Avalanche.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model's Health Points are set to 8, and its base size is changed to 75×100 SI.The model gains Maximised (Stomp Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Close Combat Weapon

Attacks made with this weapon gain +1 Strength and +1 Armour Penetration.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Artillery Weapon

This Artillery Weapon can be fired in two ways:
  • Cannon, Range 48", Shots 1, Str 5 [10], AP 2 [10], Area Attack (1×5), [Multiple Wounds (D3+1)]
  • Volley Gun, Range 12", Shots 2D6, Str 5, AP 4
A Thunder Cannon that only Pivots (and moves no further) during its owner's Movement Phase ignores the to-hit modifier from Moving and Shooting in the next Shooting Phase.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

Enemy units suffer -1 Agility for each unit of Yetis in base contact with them.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text:
Universal Rule

The model gains Breath Attack (Str 3, AP 1) and Fortitude (5+). If the model has used this Breath Attack, it regains Breath Attack (Str 3, AP 1) at the end of a Melee Phase during which the bearer caused at least four Health Point losses against enemy units with Close Combat Attacks and Stomp Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If a unit includes a Standard Bearer or a Battle Standard Bearer with Scrapling Lookout, there must be fewer than 3 R&F models before hits can be distributed onto Characters with the same Type and Height as the unit.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: When a model with Mountain Hide suffers a wound from an attack with Multiple Wounds (X), halve X, rounding fractions up.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Range 24", Shots 2, Str 4, AP 2, Quick to Fire. Counts as Paired Weapons in close combat.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Range 12", Shots 1, Str as user +1, AP as user +1, Multiple Wounds (D3, against Gigantic), Quick to Fire.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wielder gains +1 Armour, +1 Attack Value, and Parry, unless using another weapon. This weapon cannot be enchanted with Weapon Enchantments from the List of Common Special Items.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Fortitude (4+) and Multiple Wounds (2, against Large and Infantry).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Weapon Master, Plate Armour, Great Weapon, Halberd, Iron Fist, and Paired Weapons. The bearer cannot take Weapon Enchantments.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: At the end of any Melee Phase in which attacks made by the bearer have caused one or more enemy models to lose their last Health Point, roll a D6, unless the bearer is Fleeing. On a roll of 3+, the bearer's model Recovers a single Health Point.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model gains Commanding Presence (+6", max. 18") and Rally Around the Flag(+6", max. 18").

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: If the bearer selects one or more spells from Pyromancy, it gains Aegis (3+, against Flaming Attacks), Breath Attack (Str 4, AP 0, Flaming Attacks), Flaming Attacks, and can cast Fireball (Pyromancy) as a Bound Spell with Power Level (4/8). The bearer automatically fails all Fortitude Saves.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer loses Not a Leader and must be the General. Its Special Item allowance is increased to 150 pts. Another Mammoth Hunter in the army may be the Battle Standard Bearer for 50 pts; this Battle Standard Bearer gains Scrapling Lookout while joined to Yeti units. The Core limit is reduced to Min. 20%. The army may not include any Great Khans, Khans, Bruisers, Mercenary Veterans, Bombardiers, or Thunder Cannons. Mammoth Hunters become 0--4 Units/Army.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Devastating Charge (+1 Att, +1 Str, +1 AP). The Strength and Armour Penetration bonuses from this instance of Devastating Charge also affect Impact Hits and Stomp Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Poison Attacks, and all friendly Kin-Eater units may reroll Ambush rolls of 1 and 2 while the bearer is on the Battlefield. Unless the bearer is Gigantic, it gains Immune (Poison Attacks).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The model part gains Impact Hits (1). If its unit has 2 or more Full Ranks, the model part gains Impact Hits (2). A Character with Sons of the Avalanche instead gains Impact Hits (D3), or Impact Hits (D3+1) if its unit has 2 or more Full Ranks. In addition, the model is immune to the effects of Fear from enemy models.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: All Melee Attacks against the target suffer -1 to wound. {In addition, all Shamans in the target unit gain +1 Resilience.}

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with this weapon gain Multiple Wounds (D3).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Shots 4, Str 4, AP 2 (Range is dependent on which weapon is enchanted). This weapon also gains Poison Attacks (in case of Brace of Ogre Pistols, the Attack Attribute also applies to Close Combat Attacks made with it). An enchanted Ogre Crossbow loses Area Attack (1×5). Shooting Attacks made with this weapon always hit on 4+.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Attacks made with this weapon gain Lethal Strike, +1 Armour Penetration, and can never hit on worse than 3+.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wielder gains  +1 Attack Value while using this weapon. While the wielder's unit is Engaged in Combat, the wielder gains Channel (1).

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +2 Armour and +1 Strength.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +1 Armour. Attacks against the wearer can never have a Strength above 5.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +1 Resilience but automatically fails all Special Saves.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The wearer gains +1 Armour. Enemy units in base contact with the wearer suffer -1 Agility.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: In the First Round of Combat, natural to-hit, to-wound, and Armour Save rolls of ‘1’ from the bearer's unit must be rerolled, including Special Attacks.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer's unit gains Fear and automatically passes Panic Tests caused by Terror.

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: Enemy units in base contact with the bearer suffer -2 Offensive Skill. .

characteristics.name: Rule
characteristics.$text: The bearer gains Stomp Attacks (D3+1), and all models in the bearer's unit must reroll failed to-wound rolls with Stomp Attacks.
